diagnosis: All rollouts settled on the same decisions: 40 digital concurrent users, 10 print reserve copies, and scanned PDF files as the accessible format. Since these decisions match the default values implied by the public facts (S1, S2, S3, S4), the checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, and C6 did not need the hidden information PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4 to pass. This suggests the model defaulted to common choices or used easily met criteria.
